Regression: targets() identical for short/film at 30–157 s; gate output identical to HEAD for all 6 committed DNA files; synthetic wtf30 DNA PASS 28/28 and FAIL 22/28 behave correctly. brain_export.json regenerated; MONARCH_EDITOR_BRAIN.md §16 and studio/README.md link the doctrine.

Toolchain feasibility verified in this sandbox: pip install --user --break-system-packages numpy pillow scipy imageio-ffmpeg → numpy 2.4.6, Pillow 12.3.0, scipy 1.17.1, static ffmpeg 7.0.2 (libx264 + aac) in ~8 s; same imageio_ffmpeg.get_ffmpeg_exe() call TUMHARI RESERVED SEAT used. static-ffmpeg (ffprobe) cannot download here (SSL to github raw); ffprobe is optional in studio.py.

Answered "kaise hoga yeh sab" with a durable system instead of a chat-only plan: (1) MONARCH_WTF30_DOCTRINE.md — the 20–30 s impossible-moment short: one physical law broken once in one uncut shot landing at 24–40 % of the duration, everything else physically consistent, legible muted, meaning line ≤ 7 words at 70–90 %, loop seam, −14 LUFS, no CTA in picture; three thumbs (stop 0–0.8 s, share 6–10 s, save 70–90 %); ten breakable laws; engine recipes per law; 13 WTF gates; series strategy; slate of 8 set-pieces (REFLECTION LEAVES FIRST, THE GRAVITY OF THE PHONE, THODA AUR, THE THICKNESS OF FEAR, THE PAGE FLOOR, THE STAIRCASE THAT ISN'T, INK GOES BACK, THE DOOR INSIDE THE EYE). (2) Brain v2.3: `concept.py propose --format wtf30` with coherent signature→world/law/device briefs and format-aware gate #20. (3) Toolchain verified (numpy/Pillow/scipy/static ffmpeg via pip). Honest constraint: no text-to-video model here; the impossible is AI stills + code physics + synthesized sound + generated VO, which is what makes it exact and measurable. Next: the user picks a slate number (or `WTFGO <topic>`) and a style (paper WF-01 / noir WF-03); then look sheet → VO audition → set-piece code → render → gates.

WTF-30 format designed and installed: doctrine (studio/editor-brain/MONARCH_WTF30_DOCTRINE.md), brain v2.3 (library.py laws/set-pieces/hooks/devices/worlds/signatures; concept.py --format wtf30 targets, coherent propose, DNA fields, gate rows), editor-brain §16 + studio/README links, brain_export regenerated, repository manifest regenerated, validate 19 PASS / 0 FAIL, toolchain feasibility verified (numpy, Pillow, scipy, static ffmpeg 7.0.2 via imageio-ffmpeg).
